description:
Perform a Bayesian Repeated Measures ANOVA on the Extraversion items to see if they are endorsed differently.

1. Open '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BigFivePersonalityTraits.csv' in JASP.
2. Go to ANOVA > Bayesian Repeated Measures ANOVA.
3. Create a Repeated Measures Factor named 'Item' with 5 levels.
4. Assign the columns E1, E2, E3, E4, and E5 to the levels of the 'Item' factor.
5. Ensure Bayes Factor is set to BF10 (evidence for the alternative).
6. Under 'Descriptives', enable 'Descriptive plots' with 'Item' on the horizontal axis to visualize which item has the highest mean.
7. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/Extraversion_BayesianANOVA.jasp'.
8. Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/rm_anova_results.txt' with the following two lines:
   BF10: [Value of BF10 from the Model Comparison table]
   Highest Item: [Name of the item (E1-E5) with the highest mean score based on the plot]
